Containment of J in ker(x) is concluded, never assumed.

The original descent input remains explicit; same finite and infinity components yield the dual weight, outside-set unramifiedness, and the depth-one v0 vector, while every type and reciprocity test is carried into the exact HPT17 endpoint.
